direction: WonderPages → Agent Bridge only. Nothing is ever read back from the Bridge into WonderPages automatically.
include: Every file tracked in the exported source commit, except the explicit exclusions below. Untracked and ignored files (node_modules, data/, .env, logs, out/) are never exported because only git objects of the commit are read.

exclude.reason: Binary archives (Dinosaur World v04 reference project and Enterprise package): frozen reference data, not auditable as text, 11.7 MB. Path, size, sha256 and git blob id are recorded in the manifest so their identity stays verifiable.

secretScan.rule: Every exported text file is scanned. A match that is not a documented benign fixture aborts the whole export (fail closed); nothing partial is written.
